settings.sentence: The text Claude Code adds to commit messages and pull request descriptions, or none at all.

suggest.reason: Offer built-in text, custom text or hidden (false, needs v2.1.281 or later). A project rule that already states the trailer needs no second copy.

settings.default: unset (auto in terminal and VS Code sessions since v2.1.283)
settings.sentence: The permission mode new sessions start in; manual is the name of default (it asks before most actions).

suggest.reason: Leave unset: auto is the built-in start mode since v2.1.283, and auto or bypassPermissions in a project or local file is silently ignored.

settings.sentence: The model Claude Code starts with, an alias or a full model ID.

suggest.reason: Leave unset.

settings.sentence: The default effort for models without a saved level of their own; in the user file Opus 5.5 and later ignore it, and Haiku 5.5 (default medium) most likely does too, since it came after Opus 5.5 (inferred from the docs wording).

suggest.reason: Leave unset; if effort is wanted, write modelSettings.<model>.effortLevel (what /effort writes) in Advanced. The global setup offers the level of claude-haiku-5-5 as an optional change, off by default.

settings.sentence: The model that answers when Claude calls the advisor tool; it must rank at least as high as the main model.

suggest.reason: Off by default: experimental, extra token cost, Anthropic API only.

settings.sentence: Connect Remote Control automatically when an interactive session starts.
Opts out of error reporting; any value counts as set, including 0 and false.
Turns off the "How is Claude doing?" session quality surveys.
Disables the /feedback command, Claude-drafted feedback, /bug and /share.
Opts out of telemetry and stops feature-flag fetching; any value counts as set, including 0 and false.

suggest.reason: Never preset: it turns flag fetching off, so the advisor stays off and idle compaction and /import go.

settings.sentence: Opts out of telemetry like DISABLE_TELEMETRY, including the stop of flag fetching; 0 leaves telemetry on.

suggest.reason: Never preset: it turns flag fetching off.

settings.sentence: Stops feature-flag fetching and uses code defaults for every flag; 0 leaves fetching on.

suggest.reason: Never preset: Remote Control and the advisor become unavailable.

settings.sentence: Stops auto-updates, telemetry, error reporting, feedback and flag fetching; any value counts as set, including 0 and false.

suggest.reason: Never preset: it also stops auto-updates and makes Remote Control unavailable.

settings.sentence: How Claude Code notifies you when a task completes or a permission prompt waits.

suggest.reason: Docs default.

settings.sentence: The interface color theme, built-in or a custom one.
Changes Claude's role, tone and output format with a built-in or custom output style.
A command that renders the status line below the prompt; edit it in the file, the app shows it.
Runs Bash commands in a sandbox on macOS, Linux and WSL2.

suggest.reason: On where the platform supports it, per project (project setup writes it to the local file). Linux and WSL2 need bubblewrap and socat; without them commands run unsandboxed unless failIfUnavailable is true.

settings.default: unset (false: commands run unsandboxed when the sandbox cannot start)
settings.sentence: Stops Claude Code at startup when the sandbox cannot start, instead of running commands without it.

suggest.reason: With sandbox.enabled on, a missing bubblewrap or socat otherwise leaves every command unsandboxed without a stop. Setup does not write it: it is the user's choice, via benchkeeper settings set.

settings.default: unset (true: a blocked command may be retried outside the sandbox)
settings.sentence: Lets Claude retry a command the sandbox blocked outside the sandbox; false forbids the retry.

suggest.reason: A prompt injection can ask for the unsandboxed retry. False closes it; a tool that needs full access goes in sandbox.excludedCommands. Setup does not write it.

settings.sentence: Strips credentials from the environments of the Bash commands, hooks and stdio MCP servers Claude Code starts; GitHub tokens and proxy settings stay.

suggest.reason: A prompt injection that runs a command can read provider and cloud tokens from the environment. Leave it unset if a subprocess needs one of the removed variables.

settings.sentence: Rules that stop Claude's file tools from reading a path. Doctor expects Read rules for the .ssh, .aws and .config/gh folders (the last holds the GitHub CLI login), for example Read(//**/.ssh/**); a script that opens the files itself is not covered.
Days Claude Code keeps session transcripts before a silent sweep deletes them; the Sessions board reads them.

suggest.reason: Keep the default 30 or higher: transcripts are deleted without a message (anthropics/claude-code#59248), and a lower value shortens the Sessions board history.

settings.sentence: The release channel auto-updates follow; stable is about one week old and skips major regressions.

suggest.reason: About one week old and skips major regressions, the same idea as the app's 7-day rule for tools.

settings.sentence: How long the main conversation's prompt cache holds: 5 minutes, or an hour at a higher cache write cost.
Includes the built-in commit and pull request instructions and the git status snapshot in Claude's context.
Lets Claude read from and write to the auto memory directory.
Skips the WebFetch hostname check when Anthropic is unreachable.
Deprecated: use attribution; false drops the commit trailer and the pull request text unless attribution sets them.

Rules that always prompt, also in auto mode, where a pull request or a push to the default branch would otherwise pass the classifier. Bash(git push *) and Bash(gh pr create *) are the two checkpoints; a push through git -C dir push does not match, so use a PreToolUse hook for a hard stop.

suggest.reason: A human checkpoint on push and pull request creation, for people who run several repositories. Setup writes none; it costs one prompt per push.

settings.sentence: Makes the file tools refuse reads outside the working directories in every permission mode, and with the sandbox on denies sandboxed commands reads of the home folder. Sibling repositories then need /add-dir or permissions.additionalDirectories.

suggest.reason: One key instead of a growing deny list; plan for the folders a session must still read.

settings.sentence: Disclosure: with the sandbox on, sandboxed commands run without a permission prompt by default; false prompts for them. A repository's own settings file can set it, unless a user or managed file does.

suggest.reason: Leave unset to keep the default (true); set false to prompt for sandboxed commands.

settings.sentence: User settings only: project and local files are not read for it. Rules for the auto mode classifier; a list replaces the built-in section unless it holds "$defaults". Writing the key replaces the whole object, soft_deny, environment and hard_deny included.

allow: Allow `gh pr merge` in the session's repository when the user's message asks to merge that pull request; never with --admin or --force, never for CI changes, and never for a merge the agent starts itself.

suggest.reason: Auto mode blocks a merge nobody approved, and a squash merge is the same command. Whether the classifier honours the exclusion clauses is unverified.

bundles.label: Less noise
bundles.sentence: Error reporting, the quality survey and the feedback command off; none of them turns off flag fetching, so the advisor keeps working.

settings.sentence: The model Codex uses.
Reasoning effort, a value the selected model advertises, such as low, medium or high.
When Codex pauses for approval before running commands; a granular table form exists and is shown, not edited.

suggest.reason: Codex recommends on-request with workspace-write in version-controlled folders; it may start read-only until a directory is trusted. Never offered: never together with danger-full-access.

settings.sentence: Sandbox policy for file and network access while commands run.

suggest.reason: Pairs with on-request (see approval_policy); or leave both unset.

settings.sentence: Web search mode: cached results by default, live only on request.

suggest.reason: Leave unset (cached); live only on request.

settings.sentence: false turns off OpenAI analytics on this machine and the custom OTLP metrics exporters.

suggest.reason: The less-noise switch: documented key; also stops custom OTLP metrics exporters.

settings.sentence: false turns off feedback collection across Codex surfaces.

suggest.reason: The less-noise switch.

settings.sentence: A command Codex runs for notifications; it receives a JSON payload.
Desktop notifications from the terminal UI (a list of event types is shown, not edited).
Whether Codex saves session history to history.jsonl.
Checks for Codex updates on startup; set false only when updates are managed centrally.
